name: Hanime1
notes: Test26 begins the planned creator/product UX stage after Test24 avatar recovery and Test25 reply performance work. It adds an author directory and dedicated author/uploader profile experience without requiring a new Shell page, reusing hanimeVideoResults routing. Search and filter pages expose author discovery, video detail is reorganized around a four-action primary row (play/comments/playlist/download), creator cards open their own profile views, and settings is simplified while preserving Shell v4 updater/recovery safety.
